dossier.scp_unleashed.465.title: Party in a Box
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.caption: SCP-465 at intake with its lid closed, beside its evidence tag. Confetti was found in the photography booth afterwards.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.0.text.0: SCP-465 is kept closed in a standard storage locker in a low-traffic wing. It requires no feeding or maintenance. It is not to be opened outside approved testing.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.0.text.1: Testing takes place in a sealed test room no more than twenty metres on a side. Everyone taking part is to be inside the room before the lid is lifted. **No one is to enter the room once testing has begun.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.0.text.2: The test room is to be photographed before each test. %rThe photographs have never been needed.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.text.0: SCP-465 is a cube-shaped cardboard box about thirty centimetres on a side, with a separate lid hinged at the back. It is printed sky blue and covered in confetti: purple sparkles, yellow stars and red and green flecks. PARTY BOX is printed across the lid in chunky yellow letters. The only maker's mark is a small smiling face printed on the base.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.text.1: When the lid of SCP-465 is lifted inside an enclosed room, the room is decorated for a party within seconds. Streamers, balloons, coloured lights, a dance floor, a snack table and a disc jockey's booth appear, fitted to the size and shape of the room. The walls, floor and ceiling are not changed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.text.2: A number of humanoid figures appear at the same moment, designated SCP-465-1. They include clowns, a disc jockey and guests who introduce themselves as relatives and friends of the people present, though none has ever been identified. Each wears a visible name. Instances cheer for the people in the room before the music begins, then dance, eat and talk among themselves. They cannot be harmed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.text.3: When SCP-465 is closed again, every instance and decoration disappears and the room returns to the exact state it was in before the lid was lifted. Each person present later receives a small letter.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.1.text.4: SCP-465 will not open in the open air, or in rooms that are too large or too small. In these cases the box rattles and the lid stays shut.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.2.title: Addendum 465-1: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.2.text.0: Test 465-02: Dr. Hale lifted the lid in a furnished office. Within seconds the office held a dance floor and a snack table. A clown shook Dr. Hale's hand, and a guest wearing the name Your Mother asked whether Dr. Hale was eating properly. The lid was closed after twenty minutes. The office was restored to the last paperclip.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.2.text.1: Test 465-04: the lid was lifted in a storage bay with one wall missing. The box rattled and would not open.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.2.text.2: Test 465-05: D-4410 was sent into the test room after the party had begun. %rResult withheld. Testing of this kind is suspended.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.2.text.3: Test 465-07: researchers were offered punch, chips and cupcakes from the snack table. The food was ordinary and stayed fresh after the test. %rRequests for seconds were not always granted.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.3.title: Addendum 465-2: Letters
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.3.text: Everyone still in the room when the lid closes later finds a small envelope sealed with a heart sticker. Each holds a piece of chocolate and a short handwritten note. The notes are kind. Several staff have asked to keep theirs, and the requests have been granted.
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.4.title: Addendum 465-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.465.page.4.text: SCP-465 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_box.1: SCP-465, Party in a Box, is a sky-blue cardboard box printed with confetti. The lid reads PARTY BOX.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_box.2: Open it somewhere with four walls, a floor and a ceiling. The box knows when a room is too open, too big or too small, and rattles instead of opening.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_box.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-465 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A cheerful courier will bring the box to you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_letter.1: A Party Letter. Everyone still at an SCP-465 party when the lid closes is sent one. Use it to open it.
A small piece of chocolate that comes inside a Party Letter.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_food.1: Party food from the snack table at an SCP-465 party. It keeps long after the party is over.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp465_party.1: Decorations that turn up at an SCP-465 party and vanish when it ends. They cannot be broken by hand.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.title: Party Letter
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.heading: Thank You!
commands.scp_unleashed.scp465.entry: Party %s at %s: %s guests of honour, %s instances
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp465.0: The same top-hatted courier as SCP-018. He brought balloons.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp465.1: Open it indoors, with everyone already inside.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.0: Thank you for coming. The party was better with you there.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.1: We saved you a seat, and you came. That is all we ever hoped for.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.2: You have a wonderful laugh. Don't keep it to yourself.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.3: Thanks for dancing with us. Nobody minded the missed steps.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.4: It meant a lot that you came. Come back any time.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.5: The cake was good, but the company was better.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.6: You make a room feel warmer just by walking into it.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.7: Thank you for being there. Some days that is the whole gift.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.8: We hope you had as much fun as we did.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.9: You were the best part of the evening.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.10: Remember to rest. You've earned it.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.11: The music was loud, but we still heard you cheering.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.12: Whatever tomorrow brings, tonight you were celebrated.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.13: Thank you for sharing the night with us. We'll remember it.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.14: Thank you for coming, %s. The party was better with you there.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.15: %s, you are always welcome at our table.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.16: We're so glad you came, %s. It wouldn't have been the same without you.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.17: Dear %s, thank you for the dances and the laughs.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.18: %s, you are loved more than you know.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.19: To %s: you did well today. Be proud of yourself.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.20: Thank you, %s. Your smile made the whole room brighter.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.21: %s, we hope this little treat makes you smile.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.22: Here's to you, %s. The guest of honour, every time.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp465_letter.note.23: Sleep well, %s. You were wonderful company.
